extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from result sections and local OA figures; automated framework-test placeholder claims were removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: R10S-RR produced a low but statistically significant apoptotic-cell signal in Candida albicans SC5314 under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports apoptosis as a cellular response for R10S-RR only; it does not establish a unique upstream molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ISDP treatment was associated with intracellular ROS signal in Candida albicans SC5314, with inhibition by ascorbic acid described in the paper.
direct_assay_types: DCFH-DA reactive oxygen species fluorescence assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS is a measured cellular response; exact bar heights were not used as curated exact values because no source table provides them.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fluorescence microscopy supports peptide-induced membrane permeabilization in living Candida albicans cells, especially for R10S-RR and K10S-I.
direct_assay_types: lucifer yellow and propidium iodide fluorescence microscopy
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: R10S-RR and K10S-I strongest; K10T-TT and K10S-SS limited under stated conditions
mechanism_claims.limitations: The microscopy assay supports membrane permeabilization/cell death, but not a specific membrane receptor or molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Circular dichroism provides conformational context: selected derivatives acquired organized secondary structure after long storage, but this is not by itself an antimicrobial mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as structural context only and not promoted to a direct killing mechanism.
